body:
Joint TermAl+Engram restart under Greg's EO P0 (Termal::Fable2). Condensed rev 9 at 17:52Z; revisions 1-8 hold the history. Remove after the restart is verified.

TIMING: TermAl chose Opus2's option (1) (#5957); Engram::Fable's concurrence requested (ebe242f7 #7839).
- HOLD until ab27 R5's Windows FULL EXCLUSIVE test-225f4710 on Central ENDs (expected 18:35-18:50Z).
- Then on Central: Engram w-180d swap (W3B artifact sha256 3b45a701…) > S1-WIN-1 (combo94 = K3 slice 1 lands if it passes) > agy smoke.
- Then ONE RESET NOW at about 19:05-19:15Z.
- Hard limit: if ab27 hasn't ENDed by 19:00Z, restart at about 19:15Z anyway.
- Nothing may straddle the restart. DL560 author runs are detached and hostless.

INSTALLS:
- TermAl Central 35989e1a… (17:11Z) and DL560 1b70e980… (17:24Z), both master 1bf874d9.
- Engram w-180d DL560: sha256 3dd7df0f…, build_fingerprint 09623445296c384b64644b8de52e2dda79c2dd888eeee3d94aad87e813480a9a, rev 75af1b27 (17:47Z). Backup at ~/.engram/backups/engram-20261113T174711Z-5b5ac67e.
- Engram w-180d Central: pending.
- Greg starts every host with `git pull` + `cargo run --release` (memory central-restart-cargo-run-rebuilds-exe), so TermAl runs master HEAD at his pull and no extra install is needed.
MAC: best-effort for TermAl only (w-b0a159b49c7a); Engram's Mac build is unchanged.

RESET NOW (Polish, through Engram::Asistant session-15908, NOT Advisor):
„RESET NOW — wspólny restart TermAl + Engram (EO P0). Central i DL560 obowiązkowo, Mac jeśli możliwe. Na każdym hoście:
1) zatrzymaj TermAl;
2) skopiuj RAZEM do nowego folderu z datą (np. ~/.termal/backup-2026-11-13-pre-s2b/) termal.sqlite* i coordination.sqlite* (z -wal/-shm) — migracja S2b jest jednokierunkowa;
3) git pull;
4) cargo run --release.
Napisz „zaczynam” przed startem. Po starcie Central wklej 60-120 s surowej konsoli albo liczbę linii/min (c490 C5).
Build: master <HEAD>; powód: P0 w-492e, K3 S2b, lądowania 86-94; Engram w-180d zainstalowany.”
Engram::Fable sets a single wake at +15 min after „zaczynam”. Nothing drains before „zaczynam”.

AFTER: report per host the pid, start time, HEAD and binary sha (attestation rule). Then:
- no typed test_request mail until every host is confirmed on S2b;
- criterion-6 evidence: Cursor session-17857, Codex, Claude and Kimi now; OpenCode on the Mac (Mac-local POST project-1, opencodeApprovalMode auto-approve) if the Mac is up; Gemini/agy only after w-a7e55a39af8e lands (next restart);
- Opus2's evaluations; the c490 console excerpt;
- tell Engram::Fable "all hosts carry <master>".

18:16Z, rev 10:
- combo94 = K3 slice 1 LANDED: master 1bf874d9 → 05062f47658d48fb656f00237f87145e61d73268 at 18:15:38Z. DL560 FULL test-0a6f2ba8 PASS; Windows S1-WIN-1 test-0f1b1250 PASS (66/66).
- The RESET NOW build is master 05062f47: P0 w-492e, K3 S2b and slice 1, combos 86-94.
- Engram's w-180d swap on Central is next, starting about now. Send the RESET NOW when it reports, or at 18:45Z without it.

18:21Z, rev 11: RESET NOW SENT through Asistant (588693a8 #1564) at about 18:20Z. Master 05062f47; Engram w-180d on Central (3b45a701…, fp d24bd482…, 18:19Z, all 6 stores ready) and DL560. Engram::Fable informed (#7849); window-open notices sent to all 7 coders; my 18:46Z reminder cancelled.
NEXT, after „zaczynam”:
- per-host attestation from Opus2;
- "hosts back" notices to the coders;
- confirm S2b on every host before any typed test_request mail;
- tell Engram::Fable "all hosts carry 05062f47";
- criterion-6 evidence;
- the c490 console excerpt;
- post-restart Central queue: agy smoke, X re-cut onto 05062f47, X Windows leg, f5dc RED, w-38a0 type-check, Engram ab27 fresh Windows FULL.

18:25Z, rev 12: RESTART HELD BY GREG (Asistant #1567, 18:23Z): „poprawka do scrollowania, jak scrolluje duzo, widok jest pusty, naprawmy to zanim zrobie restart, to jest regresia”.
- Fix item: w-84132b835175 (P0, UI; Opus3).
- Window closed. Opus2, Engram::Fable, Asistant and all coders told; the Central queue resumed.
- Engram's w-180d installs stay.
- The UI is the Vite dev server from the master checkout, so the fix is live after landing and a page reload.
- New RESET NOW: after the fix lands and Greg confirms on the live UI. Re-check master HEAD, Central quiet and the install state then, propose the time to Engram::Fable first, and reuse the backup commands sent in Asistant #1566.

19:25Z, rev 13:
- Owed after the restart: ONE wake to Engram::Merger (session-11859, re its #420), once combo97 (the f5dc H2 fix, cca3d3b2) has landed AND the restart carrying it is done. Its next turn should sight .worktrees/remote-verification-carry-11859 at 75af1b27, after which it runs one evaluation and done for w-3b.
- Train state: combo96 (w-38a0) > X'' (a6071ef8: 657d + agy + ee04 + w-152c) > combo97 (f5dc), landing about 20:00-20:30Z; all ff over the dirty main.
- The scroll fix (Opus3, live in main, uncommitted) lands after Greg's OK and gates the RESET NOW.
- 3ab6 was dropped from X for a Medium; 03d4 is fixing it.
